text:
Rae: Noticed a nasty layout jump on small phones when opening the left rail. Steps: Console home -> narrow viewport (<=360px) -> tap rail toggle -> table rows shift up and last row clipped. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.screens/rail-clip.png

Devon: I can repro on an actual iPhone SE. The header height changes when address bar collapses and our 100vh-based container recalculates mid-animation, causing the jump.

Marta: Two quick options: listen to visualViewport resize and animate translateY instead of changing height, or use padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) and keep container height in CSS but avoid toggling overflow.

Hiro: Also seeing popover z-order problems: when rail overlays, the row action popover sits beneath the rail. Portaling popovers to a root layer fixes it but we need to ensure focus order isn't broken.

Rae: We currently use transform on the rail for smooth hardware-accelerated animation, but transforms create stacking contexts that clip descendants. If popovers are children they get clipped. We can portal or remove transforms for open state and animate left/right via translateX on a non-parent element.

Devon: On breakpoints: should the rail switch to overlay at 420 or 440? On some Androids 420 still squeezes the table too much. My vote: overlay at <=440, icons-only between 440-520.

Marta: Proposal: three modes: full rail >=521px, icons-only 441-520px, overlay <=440px. Add CSS variables for the thresholds so product can tweak without code changes.

Hiro: Accessibility: when overlay is open, trap focus and set aria-hidden on the main content. Also change the toggle label to "Open navigation" / "Close navigation" for screen reader clarity.

Rae: Small copy tweak: mobile tooltip should be disabled by default on touch devices; tooltips with hover delays block taps. Also reduce visual motion preference respect for the rail animation (use prefers-reduced-motion).

Devon: Implementation plan: 1) portal popovers to body with fixed positioning; 2) switch rail to overlay at 440px and icons-only 441-520; 3) add visualViewport listeners to prevent 100vh reflow; 4) add a11y attrs (aria-expanded, aria-hidden, focus-trap). I'll open a PR and include device screenshots.

Marta: Can design add states in the sandbox for the three breakpoints and a toggle showing focus-trap overlay? I want to run keyboard-only nav flows.

design-bot: Created sandbox variants (360, 440, 480) and linked automated visual diff. Tags: mobile-responsive, accessibility, ux.
